title: 2.7 Safe Work Conditions and Safety Guidelines
description: Connecting a monitor, general safety and fire safety guidelines

questions.question: What is the first step in connecting a monitor to a workstation?
options: Match the cable with a video port
Turn on the computer and the monitor
Find the monitor's connector cable
Connect the power cord to a power outlet
questions.correctAnswer: Find the monitor's connector cable

questions.question: After finding the monitor's connector cable, what should you do next?
options: Match the cable with one of the video ports on the back of the monitor
Insert a USB device
Plug the power cord into a surge protector
Turn on the monitor power button
questions.correctAnswer: Match the cable with one of the video ports on the back of the monitor

questions.question: In the monitor connection procedure, where should the flat end of the monitor power cord be connected?
options: To the Ethernet port
To the back of the monitor
To the front of the computer
To a USB port
questions.correctAnswer: To the back of the monitor

questions.question: According to the steps, the other end of the monitor power cord should be connected into a power outlet or preferably what?
options: A surge protector
An Ethernet switch
A USB hub
A RAM slot
questions.correctAnswer: A surge protector

questions.question: Safe work conditions and procedures for computer-related work are essential to ensure what?
options: Faster internet speeds at the workplace
Higher screen resolution on all monitors
Lower electricity bills every month
The well-being and safety of employees who spend a significant amount of time working with computers
questions.correctAnswer: The well-being and safety of employees who spend a significant amount of time working with computers

questions.question: Why should the workspace be kept clean and organized?
options: To improve the monitor's color accuracy
To reduce the cost of software licenses
To increase the computer's processing speed
To prevent tripping hazards and allow easy access to equipment
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent tripping hazards and allow easy access to equipment

questions.question: Which guideline helps protect a computer from power surges and outages?
options: Use surge protectors and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS)
Use wireless keyboard and mouse
Use a larger monitor
Increase the screen brightness
questions.correctAnswer: Use surge protectors and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS)

questions.question: Why is it recommended to regularly back up important data?
options: To make the computer boot faster
To protect against data loss in the event of hardware failure, malware attacks or other unforeseen circumstances
To reduce the number of cables needed
To increase the size of the hard drive
questions.correctAnswer: To protect against data loss in the event of hardware failure, malware attacks or other unforeseen circumstances

questions.question: What should be done to protect a computer from malware and viruses?
options: Install and regularly update reputable antivirus software
Disable all user accounts
Delete all email messages
Keep the computer turned off at all times
questions.correctAnswer: Install and regularly update reputable antivirus software

questions.question: Why should you be cautious when opening email attachments or clicking on links?
options: They can potentially contain malware or phishing attempts
They can damage the keyboard
They can increase the monitor's refresh rate
They can slow down the printer
questions.correctAnswer: They can potentially contain malware or phishing attempts

questions.question: Which tool is suggested to securely store and manage your passwords?
options: A spreadsheet on the desktop
A note attached to the monitor
A password manager
A shared text document
questions.correctAnswer: A password manager

questions.question: Which posture is recommended for good ergonomics while working at a computer?
options: Back slouched, knees raised and wrists bent downward
Sitting on the edge of the chair with feet crossed
Back straight, feet flat on the floor and wrists in a neutral position
Lying back with the monitor at eye level below the desk
questions.correctAnswer: Back straight, feet flat on the floor and wrists in a neutral position

questions.question: What does the 20-20-20 rule recommend?
options: Every 2 hours, rest for 20 minutes with 20 candles lit
Every 20 minutes, take 20 steps and drink 20 sips of water
Every 20 minutes, look away from the screen and focus on something 20 feet away for at least 20 seconds
Every 20 seconds, blink 20 times for 20 minutes
questions.correctAnswer: Every 20 minutes, look away from the screen and focus on something 20 feet away for at least 20 seconds

questions.question: Which display settings are recommended to adjust to reduce eye strain?
options: Screen orientation and wallpaper
Mouse pointer speed and volume
Network IP address and DNS server
Brightness, contrast and font size
questions.correctAnswer: Brightness, contrast and font size

questions.question: What is the purpose of using screensavers or power-saving settings?
options: To increase the processor's clock speed
To prevent screen burn-in
To enlarge the keyboard characters
To speed up the internet connection
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent screen burn-in

questions.question: Which of these is an example of a social engineering attack?
options: Adjusting the monitor height
Installing a larger hard drive
Phishing attempts or phone scams
Using a surge protector
questions.correctAnswer: Phishing attempts or phone scams

questions.question: What should you do if you notice unusual activity or a security breach on your computer or network?
options: Report it to your IT department or system administrator immediately
Ignore it until the next maintenance window
Restart the computer and say nothing
Share the details on social media
questions.correctAnswer: Report it to your IT department or system administrator immediately

questions.question: What does the PASS method for using a fire extinguisher stand for?
options: Push the lever, Aim at the top, Spray, Stop
Pull the hose, Aim high, Shake, Spray
Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the fire, Squeeze the handle, Sweep from side to side
Point, Alert, Spray, Secure
questions.correctAnswer: Pull the pin, Aim at the base of the fire, Squeeze the handle, Sweep from side to side

questions.question: Why should cables and cords not be run under carpets or rugs?
options: Doing so protects the cables from wear
Doing so increases network speed
Doing so improves audio quality
Doing so can cause overheating
questions.correctAnswer: Doing so can cause overheating

questions.question: Why should computer equipment be placed in a well-ventilated area?
options: To reduce the monitor's resolution
To increase the amount of dust collected
To make the equipment run louder
To prevent overheating caused by restricted airflow
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent overheating caused by restricted airflow

questions.question: True or False: A no-smoking policy helps prevent the risk of fire caused by discarded cigarette butts or ashes near computers.
options: False
True
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: True or False: Important data backups should be stored off-site or in a secure location to protect against loss in the event of a fire.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True

questions.question: True or False: Extension cords should be used as much as possible for computer equipment.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
